subject: Leadership recap: AtlasAI discovery — outcomes, risks, and procurement path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jmatthews@atlasai.com>, Priya Sood <priya.sood@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership recap: AtlasAI discovery — outcomes, risks, and procurement path

Thanks Jordan and Priya — great conversation today. Below is a concise leadership-oriented recap (so your exec sponsor / procurement team can scan quickly), plus next steps from Redwood.

High-level business outcomes discussed
- Improve customer support automation: target 30% reduction in manual triage time within 3 months post-pilot.
- Reduce inference cost per query by ~3x through batching, KV caching, and model selection.
- Enable PII-safe routing: hybrid private deployment for PII workflows and hosted for lower-sensitivity traffic.

Top pain points we heard
- Latency variability during peak (affects agent handoffs and SLA for key customers).
- Cost unpredictability across bursty workloads.
- Security & compliance: need SOC 2, data residency controls, and clear egress/retention policy.
- Vendor lock-in concerns / desire for model portability.

Recommended pilot & procurement path (agreed on call)
1) Pilot (6 weeks): dedicated pool + sample traffic, defined success metrics (attached).
2) Security review: deliver SOC 2 artifacts, pen-test summary, architecture diagram.
3) SOW + pricing: draft SOW from Redwood -> procurement redlines -> PO.
4) Production roll: canary rollout with fallback to hosted model variants.

Executive sponsor(s) and procurement leads
- Exec sponsor: Priya Sood (CPO) — long-term owner of outcomes.
- Day-to-day champion: Jordan Matthews (Head of ML) — technical owner.
- Procurement contact (please confirm): procurement@atlasai.com

Escalation / risk items to flag for leadership
- Custom IP/data handling needs (NDA / contract clause required).
- SOC 2 + pen-test timeline — may delay SOW if not available within 2 weeks.
- Pricing approval threshold for bespoke single-tenant options.

Attachments we discussed
- SOW-outline.xlsx (outline of pilot scope and commercial model)
- Pilot-success-metrics.docx (suggested KPIs + measurement plan)

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA)
- Redwood: send security pack + SOW draft by Mon 2026-11-09 (Ben)
- AtlasAI: confirm procurement contact and target PO timeline by EOD Fri 2026-11-06 (Jordan/Priya)
- All: 30-min procurement + security sync — propose Tue 2026-11-10 10:00 PT (calendar invite to follow)

Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment stubs: SOW-outline.xlsx, Pilot-success-metrics.docx

Thanks Ben — useful summary. Quick clarifications from our side:
- Confirming Priya (CPO) is the exec sponsor and will own sign-off. I (Jordan) will run the technical pilot.
- Procurement team email is procurement@atlasai.com (they handle SOW/PO).
- Two asks up front: can Redwood provide (a) single-tenant pricing for dedicated capacity (ballpark) and (b) 99th percentile latency at 2k concurrent requests for the recommended model family?

I attached our procurement checklist for visibility.

Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:02:15 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership recap: AtlasAI discovery — outcomes, risks, and procurement path

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the checklist. Answers and deliverables below.

Quick answers
- Single-tenant pricing (ballpark): Dedicated pool starting at $18k/month for a 4-GPU baseline; single-tenant premium typically +25–40% depending on SLAs and retention windows. We will produce a precise quote in the SOW.
- Latency (99th percentile): for the recommended medium-sized model family under a 2k-concurrent synthetic test we observed ~210–260ms depending on sequence length. With our continuous batching + KV caching tuned for your workload we expect to be able to drive that toward your 200ms target in the pilot.

Deliverables attached
- Redwood-Security-Pack_v2.zip (SOC 2 summary, architecture diagram, data flow, retention controls)
- Pilot-SOW-Draft_v0.1.pdf (initial SOW and pilot pricing bands)

Confirmed next steps (updated)
- Redwood: upload full security pack and SOW draft (attached) — ETA: today 2026-11-06 EOD (Ben)
- AtlasAI: confirm procurement contact & preferred time for the procurement + security sync (Jordan)
- Schedule: Proposed procurement sync Tue 2026-11-10 10:00 PT — Ben to send invite after calendar check.

If you want, Connor (cc'd) can prepare a short technical appendix on how we would isolate PII traffic during the pilot.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood-Security-Pack_v2.zip, Pilot-SOW-Draft_v0.1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: AtlasAI leadership recap & approval items

Ben — thanks for taking point. Internal notes for leadership + ops before we go live with the procurement call: 

1) Pricing approval: Legal/Finance to pre-authorize up to a 20% pilot discount for AtlasAI due to strategic value (they want single-tenant later). If procurement pushes for deeper discounts, escalate to me. (Priyom, please confirm you can accept up to 20% without further review.)

2) IP / contract ask: AtlasAI asked for a custom IP/data handling clause. Legal needs the ask in writing before the procurement call; get specific examples of customer data flows if they have them.

3) Security artifacts: Good that Ben attached SOC2 summary; we should have InfoSec do a 1-hour read-through and flag any missing items this afternoon. Connor, can you stand by to estimate effort if they require an on-site pen test or additional architectural whiteboarding?

4) Timeline risk: If SOC2 full report or 3rd-party pen test is requested, we may need to push the SOW sign date by 2–3 weeks. Flag this in the procurement call as a potential blocker.

5) Sales motion: Ask AtlasAI to commit to a 6-week pilot with a defined success metrics slate (Ben's attachment) — will make commercial approval straightforward.

I'll join the 11/10 call. Ben — please include procurement@atlasai.com and Priya in the invite and attach the SOW draft and security pack.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
